channel.description: Latest articles from Santa Monica Daily Press (smdp.com)

item.title: LA County Extends Price Gouging Protections for Wildfire
item.description: Los Angeles County Board of Supervisors extends price gouging protections for 2025 wildfire survivors by 30 days, preventing rent spikes up to 100%.

item.title: LA County Reforms Mental Health Care for Homeless
item.description: Los Angeles County Board of Supervisors unanimously approved mental health care reforms for 16,000 homeless people with serious mental illness.

item.title: LA County Doubles Rent Threshold Before Eviction Allowed
item.description: Los Angeles County Board of Supervisors approved ordinance raising unpaid rent threshold from 1 to 2 months before eviction in unincorporated areas.

item.title: Santa Monica honors women civic leaders at Yellow Rose Awards
item.description: League of Women Voters of Santa Monica honored former Mayor Gleam Davis, Growing Hope Gardens founder Carolyn Day, and Angela Scott at 2026 Yellow Rose Awards.

item.title: Malibu Approves $425K for Bluffs Park Snack Shack Design
item.description: Malibu City Council unanimously approved $425,000 for snack shack design at Bluffs Park but lacks $3.3 million needed for construction.

item.title: Santa Monica Crime Down 12.5% Under New City Plan
item.description: Santa Monica's Realignment Plan reduced Part I crime by 12.5% in 2025, with police at full staffing. City Council will vote on $3M economic development fund Tuesday.

item.description: Federal prosecutors say properties in Santa Monica were among those targeted in a years-long fraud scheme that used stolen identities of elderly homeowners to fraudulently obtain millions of dollars in hard money loans, leading to the arrest of 11 defendants Thursday on federal charges. item.title: Santa Monica Chamber spotlights women shaping city's future
item.description: Over 150 business leaders attended Santa Monica Chamber's Power of Women in Leadership Luncheon, honoring UCLA Health, Shore Hotel, and Snapchat executives for their role in the city's economic recovery.

item.title: Santa Monica Mayor Calls Special Meeting on Grant Dispute
item.description: Santa Monica Mayor Caroline Torosis called a special City Council meeting to revise neighborhood grant restrictions after 3 groups rejected funding.

item.title: Courts host education event in Santa Monica
item.description: The Los Angeles County Superior Courts held a pop-up educational experience at the Santa Monica Courthouse on Tuesday. The event included displays providing educational and historic information about the court system, jury duty and legal protections. The information will be on display until 2 p.m. Tuesday.
